limitations: Physical adjacency and observed reasoning do not prove hidden model decisions.
Same-response calls may have been issued concurrently; order is rollout order.
Delayed-sequence output does not identify per-subcommand output ownership.
Sequence counts use overlapping windows and are not independent samples.
No command is executed or rewritten from rollout history.

methodology.canonical_key: granularity, ordered command identities, and parser confidence; packaging is excluded from the key
methodology.mixed_boundary_policy: Windows spanning exactly one explicit batch and direct calls are mixed; windows spanning multiple batches are unknown.
methodology.non_overlapping_metric: Greedy floor(window_count / sequence_length) per ordered chain; reported separately and not used for ranking.
methodology.ordering: physical rollout order within one source file
methodology.same_response: Assigned only from a following token_usage_record response_id; not inferred from timestamps.

transitions.warning: Conditional follow rates are observational and do not establish causality or batch safety.
